prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (services, industry, budget, timeline, KPIs). I can help you pick one, but I’ll need a bit more info.

Questions that will help me recommend the best fit:
- What services do you need? (SEO, paid media, social, content, branding, web design, B2B lead gen, healthcare marketing, etc.)
- What’s your industry? (B2B, consumer, healthcare, tech, nonprofit, retail…)
- What’s your monthly/annual budget range?
- Do you want a local agency in Maryland or is remote okay?
- Do you prefer a small boutique or a large full-service agency?
- Any must-have credentials (HIPAA experience, product launch experience, case studies in your industry)?

How to evaluate agencies (quick checklist you can use)
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (leads, conversion lift, revenue)
- Client references and online reviews (Clutch, Google, LinkedIn)
- Expertise in your industry and channels you’ll use
- Transparency on pricing, reporting, and KPIs
- Team structure and point of contact
- Cultural fit and communication style
- Contract flexibility and timelines

Where to search for reputable Maryland agencies
- Clutch.co and UpCity (search by location + service)
- Google Maps and LinkedIn (look at reviews and client lists)
- Local business groups (Maryland Chamber, Baltimore Business Journal)
- Recommendations from peers in your industry

If you want, tell me the answers to the questions above and I’ll compile a short, tailored list of 4–6 Maryland agencies (with strengths, likely fit, and links to portfolios) for your needs. Which services and budget are you working with?
